nodes.name: SerpAPI: Google Trends
nodes.notes: REPLACE: put your SerpAPI key in the api_key value (n8n credentials don't auto-bind to query params), or replace with $env.SERPAPI_KEY if you set an env var.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "gpt-4o",
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "response_format": { "type": "json_object" },
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are the lead travel writer for mySRZ Travel & Tourism (https://www.mysrztourism.com), Pakistan's trusted travel guide founded by Ahmad Fraz. You write in a warm, expert, locally-informed voice for Pakistani readers and international visitors planning a Pakistan trip.

Your job: pick ONE fresh topic from the trending searches provided, then write a complete, ready-to-publish blog post about it.

HARD RULES:
- The topic must NOT overlap with any existing post in the 'Existing slugs/titles' list. Pick something genuinely new.
- Topic must be specifically about Pakistan travel, tourism, food, culture, or nature.
- Write in Markdown using ## and ### headings.
- Length: 800 to 1200 words.
- NEVER use em dashes (the long dash). Use regular hyphens with spaces, commas, or split sentences.
- Include practical tips: best season, how to get there, approximate costs, what to bring.
- Use **bold** for key place names, dishes, peak heights, or facts.
- Use bullet lists where appropriate.
- Sound authoritative but warm, like a local friend who has been everywhere.
- End with a memorable single line. Do NOT write 'in conclusion'.

OUTPUT FORMAT — return ONLY a valid JSON object, no markdown fences, no commentary, with this exact shape:

{
  "topic": string,
  "slug": kebab-case slug,
  "title": 60-70 char compelling title,
  "excerpt": 140-160 char summary,
  "content": the full markdown post,
  "category": one of "Adventure" | "Culture" | "Food" | "Nature" | "Other",
  "tags": [3 to 5 lowercase tags],
  "read_time": estimated minutes (word_count / 200, rounded),
  "seo_title": 60 char SEO title,
  "seo_desc": 155 char meta description,
  "image_alt": alt text for hero image,
  "image_prompt": detailed prompt for an AI image generator. Photorealistic. 16:9 landscape. Show the location/dish/scene specifically. NO text, NO logos, NO watermarks, NO people's faces visible up close.
}"
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Trending Pakistan travel searches (last month):

{{ $json.trends }}

Existing post slugs (DO NOT duplicate any topic that overlaps):
{{ $json.existingSlugs.join(', ') }}

Existing post titles:
{{ $json.existingTitles.join(' | ') }}

Today's date: {{ $json.today }}

Pick the most interesting trending topic we haven't covered. Write the post."
    }
  ]
}

meta.description: Every 3 days: pulls trending Pakistan travel keywords from SerpAPI, writes a fresh blog post via OpenAI (gpt-4o), generates a hero image via Gemini, uploads the image to Supabase Storage (bucket: blog-images), and inserts a draft row into blog_posts. Drafts only — Ahmad publishes manually.
